# ReviewBuddy

> ReviewBuddy helps Australian trade businesses get more Google reviews and shows them live on their own website. It is a white-labelled review platform with setup done for the customer.

## What it does

- Gives each business a Google review link and QR code to share after every job.
- Brings reviews from the other review sites a business connects, such as Service Seeking and hipages, together with Google in the one widget.
- Puts a live Google reviews widget on the business website. It updates when a new review comes in.
- Growth plan: email sequences that keep asking customers for reviews, and a way to reach past customers (export from your job software, import by CSV).

## Offer and prices

- 7-day free trial, free setup, cancel anytime.
- Starter: $49 a month including GST.
- Growth: $75 a month including GST.
